name: Lane Public API
description:
Programmatic access to Lane — create customer feedback and read your signals. This is the same API that powers the Lane Zapier app and Chrome extension, and you can use it for any custom integration.

All requests are scoped to the workspace that owns the API key. The Public API is available on the Pro plan (and during the trial).
